changes: - `CarShapeFitter` trusts the box heading: `forward_sign` is no longer fitted (`fit_forward_sign=True` restores the sweep). Candidates are the body presets only.
- `CarShapeFitter` compares candidates after a box-height prior (`height_prior=0.15` around `suv_height_m=1.87`, span 0.1 m): taller boxes favor hatch_suv, lower ones sedan.
- `VehicleColorEstimator`: a colored minority cluster only wins over an achromatic majority darker than L* 60 (`trim_max_lightness`), so tail lights no longer tint white/silver paint.

- `VehicleColorEstimator`: neutral paint snaps to a = b = 0 (chroma < 8, unless saturated dark paint such as navy). The visible road ring around the box floor (via the depth buffer) is the gray reference: paint chroma that the road's illuminant cast explains is treated as neutral; colored paint keeps its hue.
- `VehicleColorEstimator` fusion: per-channel medians over the last 10 (a, b) / 20 (L) confident observations replace the EMA, so incompatible readings are outvoted instead of averaged.
- `PrimitiveVehicleAsset.vertex_colors_for_tint`: dark paint is lifted to about L* 25 by scaling (hue kept) before adding gray, instead of adding gray only.
- Tried and not kept: L*-only exposure normalization against the road ring (whites on bright roads dropped to L* ~76, shaded rears stayed dark, blacks got darker).
